patterns.label: AI agent workflow system
patterns.description: Agents, skills, prompts, tools, governance, and handoffs that work together as a repeatable AI workflow.
positive_signals: agent or skill assets
workflow or orchestration assets
preflight/postflight/handoff evidence
govern_agents or capture_lessons capability

patterns.label: Evaluation and contract system
patterns.description: Tests, evaluations, schemas, golden cases, and validators that prove behavior and keep agents aligned.
positive_signals: test or evaluation assets
schema or ontology assets
validate_contracts capability
golden cases or regression language

patterns.label: Knowledge graph and retrieval system
patterns.description: Ontology, taxonomy, graph, retrieval, context-pack, and index assets that help agents find and connect the right things.
positive_signals: ontology or taxonomy assets
knowledge-graph tags
retrieval tags
build_knowledge_graph or retrieve_context capability

patterns.label: Governed learning loop system
patterns.description: Lessons, handoffs, asset-use feedback, governance gates, and review loops that improve future agent behavior.
positive_signals: lesson or workflow assets
learning-loop tags
governance tags
capture_lessons capability

patterns.label: Asset-use pay-forward loop
patterns.description: A before-use and after-use workflow that records how any digital asset was found, used, upgraded, blocked, valued, and safely handed forward to future agents.
positive_signals: DAD_ASSET_USE_FEEDBACK_V1 marker
before-use expectation and after-use result fields
parts used, parts not used, difficulties, and upgrades
reuse-when, avoid-when, pay-forward, and next-agent-action guidance
candidate-only safety boundary for external or repo-local feedback
missing_evidence: paired before-use and after-use records for the same asset
reviewed examples across multiple asset types
calibrated impact on current score and ceiling ranges
curated rejection examples showing unsafe or unhelpful feedback

patterns.label: Route-isolated evaluation harness
patterns.description: Routing, chunking, form classification, context packets, scorecards, and gold cases that evaluate different asset forms without mixing authority boundaries.
positive_signals: route or form classification assets
chunk or context-packet assets
evaluation or scorecard assets
gold cases or review packets

patterns.label: Agent and skill graph system
patterns.description: Agents, skills, capability registries, tool routes, handoffs, and graph relationships that let future agents discover and compose the right capabilities.
positive_signals: agent or skill assets
capability or tool registry
handoff or orchestration workflow
knowledge-graph edges between capabilities

patterns.label: Boundary and contamination firewall
patterns.description: Rules, validators, or workflows that prevent generated candidates, retrieved context, or external assets from overriding source authority.
positive_signals: authority boundary language
candidate-only or source-owned trust zones
prompt-injection or contamination defenses
human gate or quarantine rules

patterns.label: Proposal-to-promotion workflow
patterns.description: Candidate proposals, review gates, promotion logs, validators, and rollback paths that turn observations into reviewed changes only after human approval.
positive_signals: proposal records
promotion decisions
human review gates
validator or registry update path

patterns.label: Load-bearing decision review system
patterns.description: A governed workflow that classifies high-impact software, roadmap, schema, scoring, governance, dependency, and automation decisions by risk tier before they shape downstream repos or future agents.
positive_signals: load-bearing decision or risk-tier language
fresh-eyes red-team or premortem review template
rollback, kill criteria, and bounded A/B comparison language
reviewed learning rule surfaced by preflight or midflight
tests or governance checks that prevent silent bypass
missing_evidence: measured reduction in downstream rework or false-positive defaults
fresh-eyes review records for the highest-risk decisions
human-reviewed threshold for when ceremony becomes too heavy

patterns.label: Frontier signal intake loop
patterns.description: Research, literature, watch items, external signals, and review gates that surface new ideas without automatically importing them as truth.
positive_signals: research radar assets
frontier or literature watch language
source provenance fields
license and review gates

patterns.label: Gold set and review packet system
patterns.description: Gold cases, expected outputs, review packets, labels, and scoring rubrics that make future evaluation and calibration repeatable.
positive_signals: gold or golden cases
review packets
labels or scorecards
calibration or benchmark files

patterns.label: Duplicate and variant preservation system
patterns.description: Exact identity, near-duplicate, variant, delta, and archive lineage evidence that preserves similar assets while making their differences reviewable.
positive_signals: duplicate or variant language
delta records
archive lineage
chunk, shingle, fingerprint, or hash evidence

patterns.label: Model, algorithm, or forecasting system
patterns.description: Algorithms, scoring models, forecasters, simulations, optimization models, or frontier math assets paired with tests/data.
positive_signals: code and dataset assets together
evaluation assets
score_assets capability
model, algorithm, forecast, predict, or optimize language

patterns.label: Security and governance gate system
patterns.description: Policies, hooks, tests, secret handling, prompt-injection defenses, and review gates that let assets scale safely.
positive_signals: security tags
governance tags
protect_sensitive_data capability
pre-push, policy, secret, or prompt-injection language

patterns.label: Asset cluster delta
patterns.description: Near-duplicate or variant assets compared as a cluster with shared core, strengths, neutral differences, and weaker parts.
positive_signals: similar names or capabilities
same need solved in multiple repos
near_duplicate or variant evidence
cluster-delta review notes

patterns.label: Semantic evolution grading system
patterns.description: A deterministic workflow that separates behavior-relevant evolution from copy, fixture, formatting, path, and metadata noise across asset families.
positive_signals: semantic evolution or version lineage language
explicit scoring methodology and grade registry
separate semantic_change_score and noise_score
candidate graph edges for evolved_from, semantic_variant_of, noise_variant_of, or lineage_evidence_for
tests proving semantic changes are not confused with fixture or formatting churn

patterns.label: Asset use instance
patterns.description: A specific before-use or after-use record showing how an asset was found, used, upgraded, blocked, or valued.
positive_signals: DAD_ASSET_USE_FEEDBACK_V1 marker
before_use or after_use stage
observed usefulness/futurefulness
parts used and things learned
pay-forward guidance for future agents
missing_evidence: curation into score or ceiling calibration

patterns.label: Professional recruiting intelligence workflow system
patterns.description: Official credential intake, person/credential identity, organization roster capture, public enrichment, exception review, and candidate-only recruiting or opportunity signals combined into a governed intelligence workflow.
positive_signals: official register, credential, license, membership, exam-result, or population-source intake
separate person, credential, organization, alias, source, and profile identities
source snapshots, extraction audits, source hashes, or source drill-down fields
roster, bio, profile, directory, or public source extraction scripts
enrichment lanes that explicitly cannot override official source truth
exception lake, conflict queue, no-confident-match state, or needs-review queue
opportunity, acquisition, liftout, succession, rising-star, recruiting, or market-context signals
generated exports or dashboards derived from a canonical database
tests or roadmap gates for source coverage, idempotence, scraping boundaries, evidence completeness, or stale state
missing_evidence: privacy and source-terms review for row-level person data
human-reviewed false-positive examples for identity and opportunity signals
calibrated thresholds for recruiting, acquisition, liftout, or rising-star signals
scraper variant clustering and delta review
reviewed evidence that generated exports derive from the canonical store

patterns.label: Source-faithful chunking gate system
patterns.description: A workflow that protects raw source custody, generated normalized text, source-faithful chunks, coverage audits, A/B retrieval gates, and promotion boundaries before graph, vector, or agent use.
positive_signals: source-faithful chunking, canonical chunks, or route-specific chunking language
raw source immutability, source hashes, or generated normalized source layers
coverage audits, independent validators, or source-completeness checks
A/B retrieval gates or baseline-vs-candidate chunk comparisons
explicit graph, vector, embedding, or retrieval promotion gates
missing_evidence: reviewed gold or hard-negative eval set
coverage audit that cannot be satisfied by the chunker under test

patterns.label: Exception-lake error-correction system
patterns.description: Append-only runtime observations are validated, summarized as pressure vectors or learning candidates, and routed through proposals and promotion decisions without directly mutating canon.
positive_signals: exception event, pressure vector, adaptation proposal, or promotion decision language
append-only event store, audit log, correction, supersession, or admission validation
route registry, event class registry, contract lock, or pinned schema authority
explicit no-canon-mutation, synthetic-only, or evidence-plane boundary
learning loop from repeated defects, conflicts, or retrieval misses

patterns.label: AI work-cycle governance system
patterns.description: A reusable orient, authority-check, route-classify, mode-select, stop-condition, validate, report, and lesson-capture workflow for AI-assisted repo work.
positive_signals: preflight, midflight, postflight, AI work cycle, or no-context review protocol
mode selection such as explore, plan, edit, or execute
stop conditions, allowed paths, forbidden paths, or authority confirmation
handoff ledger, audit surface, review report template, or lesson capture
validation and outcome reporting required before completion
missing_evidence: clear triggers for when the workflow is required
examples of low-risk tasks where the workflow is intentionally reduced
tests or lint checks for required handoff fields
fresh-eyes or red-team path for high-risk decisions

patterns.label: Cross-repo authority and data-flow system
patterns.description: A workflow that maps repo planes, authority order, allowed data directions, forbidden writes, principal cross-boundary objects, handoff paths, and human gates.
positive_signals: data-flow map, cross-repo map, authority order, control plane, evidence plane, or execution plane language
contract consumption, pinned SHA, read-only substrate, or source authority boundary
principal objects with owner and direction
forbidden writes, no canon mutation, no raw payload, or no direct production connector rules
human gate or promotion path for cross-boundary changes
missing_evidence: clean distinction between local copies and canonical remotes
source mutation tests or policy gates
human approval path for changing cross-repo contracts

patterns.label: Cross-repo governance dependency map pattern
patterns.description: A reusable repo-family control-plane and child-repo mirror pattern where an upstream governance map, local mirror controls, AI discovery surfaces, repo contracts, PR descriptions, validators, and tests stay aligned.
positive_signals: upstream or control-plane governance map
child-repo governance dependency-map mirror
AI front door and AI table of contents route to map or mirror
repo contract states non-override and fail-closed behavior
PR description requires governance map or mirror review
validator-backed watched governance path gate
tests for map, mirror, discovery-surface, or companion-surface drift
missing_evidence: human-reviewed upstream authority for the adopting repo family
repo-specific watched path list and companion surface list
child mirror validators in every participating child repo
proof that generated templates do not override source governance
reviewed examples from non-Logos repo families

patterns.label: Calibration and A/B gate system
patterns.description: A decision workflow that compares baseline and candidate methods against shared evals, coverage and safety gates, metric reports, human calibration, and decision packets.
positive_signals: A/B test, baseline, candidate, calibration, score review, or decision packet language
shared eval set, review sample, gold labels, precision, recall, or false-positive notes
coverage and safety gates in addition to performance metrics
human label import, review summary, or weight-change notes
explicit warning that a metric is not truth

patterns.label: Security scanner and quarantine system
patterns.description: A workflow for scanning incoming skills, prompts, tools, feedback, and external code for prompt injection, exfiltration, unsafe execution, persistence, secret access, and opaque payload risk before reuse.
positive_signals: security scanner, semantic intent, rulepack, quarantine, reject, manual review, or safe-for-eval language
prompt-injection, exfiltration, telemetry, hidden network call, persistence, destructive action, or secret access rules
risk score, risk level, finding count, or recommendation output
AI ingestion quarantine or generated material not canonical by default
tests for scanner or quarantine behavior
missing_evidence: human override policy for high-severity findings

patterns.label: Public-safe source sweep system
patterns.description: A metadata-only workflow for learning reusable architecture from private or sensitive local sources without importing scraped rows, raw snapshots, exports, or person-level facts into a public-ready DAD repository.
positive_signals: public-safe source sweep or metadata-only sweep language
explicit no row-level import and no file contents read boundary
data, raw snapshot, export, SQLite, CSV, HTML, TXT, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and ZIP quarantine rules
tracked evidence limited to methodology, aggregate categories, and workflow patterns
separate private-store gate for any future row-level cataloging
missing_evidence: tests proving private content is not surfaced
source terms and privacy review before any private row-level mode

patterns.label: Software and repo checklist tree system
patterns.description: A compositional workflow that routes software, repository, data, workflow, scoring, governance, source-scan, and release tasks through selected checklist branches based on task dimensions and risk tier.
positive_signals: task dimension or checklist-tree language
data normalization checklist with source truth, identity, field semantics, matching, and export rules
risk-tier routing for high, medium, and low impact work
fresh-eyes review, red-team, premortem, or A/B comparison triggers
validation, rollback, stop conditions, and evidence-before-promotion fields
pay-forward learning and context-bound lesson capture
missing_evidence: reviewed examples across several repo types
evidence that checklist use reduces downstream rework or false positives
human-reviewed boundary for when checklist ceremony is too heavy
tooling that auto-suggests branches from changed paths and task text

patterns.label: AI entrypoint and TOC routing system
patterns.description: A single AI front door, deterministic table-of-contents rows, routing tags, knowledge-graph entrypoints, and templates that let future agents enter a repo and know when to look deeper.
positive_signals: AI_FRONT_DOOR.md is declared as the single AI entrypoint
AI_TABLE_OF_CONTENTS.md rows include path, role description, tags, and use-when triggers
machine navigation manifest points to start files and registries
knowledge-graph entrypoints are listed from the front door and TOC
generated graph or report surfaces are explicitly candidate evidence
template or standard exists for reuse in future repos
missing_evidence: validator that checks AI TOC row shape
measured reduction in missed authority files or misrouted agent work
human-reviewed threshold for when the navigation standard is too heavy

patterns.label: Background connection radar system
patterns.description: A two-speed discovery workflow where a low-compute background scout searches current attention against cold-storage assets, then escalates unusually connective candidates to stronger verification and multi-hop expansion.
positive_signals: attention seeds or current-interest queues
cold-storage or older low-attention asset queues
cheap deterministic scout over tags, graph paths, lessons, variants, and needs
bounded escalation packets for stronger model verification
multi-hop expansion maps that separate similarity from complementarity
candidate-only generated connection records and human review gates
missing_evidence: reviewed false-positive examples for weak associations
calibrated escalation threshold and compute budget
human-reviewed promotion path from candidate connection to graph edge

patterns.label: SWE review feedback loop
patterns.description: Red-team, premortem, audit, security-review, and code-review findings from any coding agent (Fable, Opus, Codex, Claude, Cursor, human) are captured as structured lessons with attribution, mined for repeated failure patterns, and routed back into non-negotiables, harness checks, and pattern cards.
positive_signals: DAD_REVIEW_FEEDBACK_V1 marker
red-team, premortem, audit, or code-review findings with agent and model attribution
severity and confirmed/unconfirmed labels on findings
review-lane records closed in postflights
repeated finding classes promoted to rules, harness checks, or pattern cards
missing_evidence: repeated finding classes observed across multiple repos
human-reviewed promotion of a finding class into a rule or harness check
calibrated severity labels against human judgments

rule: Pattern matches are generated candidate evidence. They guide review, scoring calibration, and composite-asset proposals; they do not prove value or source truth.
